content: With the widespread adoption of electronic health records (EHRs), medical data are being generated and stored digitally in vast quantities BIBREF0. While much EHR data are structured and amenable to analysis, there appears to be limited homogeneity in data completeness and quality BIBREF1, and it is estimated that the majority of healthcare data are being generated in unstructured, text-based format BIBREF2. The generation and storage of these unstructured data come concurrently with policy initiatives that seek to utilize preventative measures to reduce hospital admission and readmission BIBREF3.
